WITH active_residency_ranked AS ( SELECT ra.id, ra.student_id, ra.room_id, ra.bed_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ra.student_id ORDER BY ra.assigned_at DESC, ra.id DESC) AS row_number FROM room_assignment ra WHERE ra.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' ), filtered_students AS ( SELECT s.id, s.student_number, s.student_name, s.gender, s.nationality_code, s.student_category, s.enrollment_source, s.phone_number, s.degree_level, s.grade_year, s.major_id, m.major_code, m.major_name, u.account_status, active_ra.id AS current_residency_id, active_ra.room_id AS current_room_id, active_ra.bed_id AS current_bed_id, (active_ra.id IS NOT NULL) AS currently_resident, current_building.building_name AS current_building_name, current_room.room_number AS current_room_number FROM student s JOIN major m ON m.id = s.major_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN active_residency_ranked active_ra ON active_ra.student_id = s.id AND active_ra.row_number = 1 LEFT JOIN room current_room ON current_room.id = active_ra.room_id LEFT JOIN dormitory_floor current_floor ON current_floor.id = current_room.floor_id LEFT JOIN dormitory_building current_building ON current_building.id = current_floor.building_id
ORDER BY
s.student_name s.gender m.major_name u.account_status s.grade_year s.student_category s.degree_level (active_ra.id IS NOT NULL) current_building.building_name s.student_number
DESCASC, s.student_number ASC, s.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ), pending_confirmation AS ( SELECT request.id, request.residency_id, request.declared_bed_id, request.request_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY request.residency_id ORDER BY request.submitted_at DESC, request.id DESC) AS row_number FROM bed_confirmation_request request JOIN filtered_students fs ON fs.current_residency_id = request.residency_id WHERE request.request_status = 'PENDING' ) SELECT s.id, s.student_number, s.student_name, s.gender, s.nationality_code, s.student_category, s.enrollment_source, s.phone_number, s.degree_level, s.grade_year, s.major_id, s.major_code, s.major_name, s.account_status, s.currently_resident, s.current_residency_id, s.current_building_name, s.current_room_number, current_bed.bed_code AS current_bed_code, current_bed.bed_type AS current_bed_type, pending_request.request_status AS selection_review_status, declared_bed.bed_code AS declared_bed_code, declared_bed.bed_type AS declared_bed_type FROM filtered_students s LEFT JOIN bed current_bed ON current_bed.id = s.current_bed_id LEFT JOIN pending_confirmation pending_request ON pending_request.residency_id = s.current_residency_id AND pending_request.row_number = 1 LEFT JOIN bed declared_bed ON declared_bed.id = pending_request.declared_bed_id ORDER BY
s.student_name s.gender s.major_name s.account_status s.grade_year s.student_category s.degree_level s.currently_resident s.current_building_name s.student_number
DESCASC, s.student_number ASC, s.id ASC
